t: Three people who get paid twice
a: ثَلاَثَةٌ لَهُمْ أَجْرَانِ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ آمَنَ بِنَبِيِّهِ، وَآمَنَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْعَبْدُ الْمَمْلُوكُ إِذَا أَدَّى حَقَّ اللَّهِ وَحَقَّ مَوَالِيهِ
p: Thalāthatun lahum ajrān: rajulun min ahli-l-kitābi āmana bi-nabiyyihi wa āmana bi-Muḥammad, wa-l-ʿabdu-l-mamlūku idhā addā ḥaqqa-Llāhi wa ḥaqqa mawālīh
m: Three have two rewards: a man of the People of the Book who believed in his prophet and believed in Muhammad, and an owned servant who fulfils the right of Allah and the right of those over him.
